questions.stem: Which statement correctly explains why an exothermic reaction releases energy?

options.text: More energy is needed to break bonds in reactants than is released forming bonds in products
More energy is released forming new bonds in products than is needed to break bonds in reactants
The products have more energy stored in their bonds than the reactants
The reaction absorbs heat from the surroundings

questions.explanation: In an exothermic reaction, the energy released when forming new bonds in the products is greater than the energy required to break the bonds in the reactants. This net surplus of energy is released to the surroundings.
